query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM channelmembers cm
                  JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.userid
                 WHERE cm.channelid = $1
                   AND u.deleteat = 0
                   AND ( COALESCE(TRIM(u.notifyprops ->> 'mention_keys'), '') <> ''
                      OR u.notifyprops ->> 'first_name' = 'true' )
            ) AS "found!"
